root_cause.issue: Two public branch-integration pages exceeded the repository SEO meta-description target and blocked the diagnostic gate.
root_cause.secondary: Shortening the Dutch text introduces new strings that must exist in the fail-closed static English cache.

prevention.seo_gate: Keep public meta descriptions within the repository's 110-165 character contract.
prevention.i18n_gate: Any new public Dutch string introduced by the fix must be added to config/bg-static-i18n-en.json in the same change.

tests: Required: Validate fail-closed static English cache before merge
